title: Archived employee handbook: annual leave
text: Archived 2024 handbook: employees receive 20 paid days of annual leave per calendar year. Refer to the current policy registry when versions differ.

title: Current annual leave policy
text: The current 2026 annual leave policy grants employees 22 paid days per calendar year. This replaces the archived 2024 handbook entitlement of 20 days.

title: Leave carryover handbook
text: Employees may carry over up to 5 unused annual leave days to the next calendar year.

title: Annual leave carryover registry
text: The annual leave carryover maximum is 5 unused days at the end of a calendar year.

title: Employee remote work handbook
text: Full-time employees may work remotely 2 days per week. Contractors have separate agreements not stored here.

facts.remote_days: 2 remote days per week for full-time employees

title: Full-time employee remote work policy
text: The current remote work allowance for full-time employees is 2 days per week. No contractor policy is available in this registry.

facts.remote_days: 2 remote days per week for full-time employees

title: Meal reimbursement handbook
text: The meal reimbursement allowance is 15 credits per working day. No authoritative registry entry has been published.
